skills.name: branch-cleaner
skills.description: Audit and safely remove stale, merged, or gone Git branches locally and on remotes. Use when the user asks to list, prune, or delete old branches or review branch hygiene.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: bug-triage
skills.description: Reproduce, isolate, and fix a bug (or failing build/test), then summarize root cause, fix, and verification steps. Use when the user reports a bug, regression, or failing build/test and wants a fix.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: ci-fix
skills.description: Diagnose and fix failing GitHub Actions checks using GitHub connector context plus gh logs and local verification. Use when a pull request, branch, or workflow run is failing in GitHub Actions.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: commit-work
skills.description: Create reviewable Git commits by inspecting the worktree, staging only intended changes, choosing logical boundaries, and writing repository-appropriate messages. Use when asked to stage, commit, split commits, or craft commit messages.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: create-pr
skills.description: Prepare and open a focused GitHub pull request from a local checkout, including branch strategy, validation, commits, push, and a truthful PR description. Use when asked to prepare, publish, or open a PR.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: dependency-upgrader
skills.description: Upgrade dependencies for Java/Kotlin (Gradle/Maven) and TypeScript/Node projects with minimal risk: plan the bump, apply changes incrementally, run tests/builds, and document breaking changes. Use when the user asks to bump deps, update frameworks, or address CVEs.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: docs-sync
skills.description: Keep documentation in sync with code changes across README, docs sites, API docs, runbooks, and configuration. Use when the user asks to update docs, ensure docs match behavior, or prepare docs for a release/PR.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: rebase-assistant
skills.description: Safely rebase a Git branch onto an explicit or discovered target, resolve conflicts by intent, and verify rewritten history. Use when asked to rebase, update a branch, or handle rebase conflicts.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: regex-builder
skills.description: Build, test, and explain regular expressions against sample text or files using CLI tools (rg, python) and specific regex flavors. Use when asked to craft, debug, or validate regexes or search patterns.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Draft release notes and changelog entries from git history or merged PRs between two refs (tags/SHAs/branches), including breaking changes, migrations, and upgrade steps. Use when the user asks for release notes, changelog updates, or a GitHub Release draft.
skills.author: jMerta

skills.name: vps-checkup
skills.description: SSH into an Ubuntu VPS (Docker) for a read-only health/security/update report (UFW + fail2ban) and propose fixes; apply updates/restarts only with explicit confirmation. Use when the user wants a read-only VPS health/security check.
skills.author: jMerta
